provenance.filter: AES-128; 128-bit tags, or supported CCM tag sizes

CounterWrap.description: AES-EAX reduces the counter value modulo 2^128. This test vector was constructed for testing the wrapping of the counter value.

ModifiedTag.description: The test vector contains a ciphertext with a modified tag. The test vector was obtained by manipulating a valid ciphertext. The purpose of the test is to check whether the verification fully checks the tag.
ModifiedTag.effect: Failing to fully verify a tag reduces the security level of an encryption.

Pseudorandom.description: The test vector contains pseudorandomly generated inputs. The goal of the test vector is to check the correctness of the implementation for various sizes of the input parameters.

SmallIv.description:
AES-EAX allows arbitrary sizes for the nonce.
           This test vector uses an IV smaller than 12 bytes.

tests.comment: no counter overflow, but the 64 most significant bits are set.
bits 32-64 and 96-128 of counter are set
lower bits of initial counter are 2^63-1
lower 64 bits of initial counter are 2^63-4
